title: Coherent higher direct images with proper support
statement: Let S be a locally Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth], let f:X\to S be a morphism locally of finite type [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], and let F be a coherent O_X-module [pqf-def-coherent] whose support is proper over S [def-weil-pbc-closed-subset-proper-over-base]. Then R^p f_*F [def-pc-derived-direct-image] is a coherent O_S-module for every integer p\ge 0.

proof.text: Apply [lem-weil-pbc-module-support-proper-over-base] to F. Since its support is proper over S, it supplies a closed subscheme i:Z\to X such that Z\to S is proper and F\cong i_*G for a finite type quasi-coherent O_Z-module G. Put g=f\circ i. The proper morphism Z\to S supplied by the support factorization is this composite g, so g is proper.

By [lem-weil-pbc-closed-immersion-integral-separated-uc] (b) the closed immersion i:Z\to X is affine, and G is quasi-coherent, so [lem-pc-affine-morphism-hi] gives R^q i_*G=0 for q>0; hence Ri_*G\cong i_*G\cong F in D(O_X). The composition isomorphism [lem-pc-derived-direct-image-composition] for Z\xrightarrow{i}X\xrightarrow{f}S, g=f\circ i, gives Rg_*G\cong Rf_*(Ri_*G)\cong Rf_*F. Taking the p-th cohomology sheaf gives R^p f_*F\cong R^p g_*G.

proof.text: The base S is locally Noetherian and g:Z\to S is proper, hence of finite type [def-weil-proper-morphism], in particular locally of finite type; so Z is locally Noetherian by [pqf-lem-locnoeth-lft]. G is quasi-coherent of finite type on the locally Noetherian scheme Z, hence coherent by [pqf-lem-coherent-ft-locnoeth]. Thus [lem-pc-coherent-hi] applies to the proper morphism g and the coherent module G, making R^p g_*G coherent for every p\ge0. Via the isomorphism of Step 2, R^p f_*F is coherent for every p\ge0.

split_report.summary: Checked the item against Stacks Cohomology of Schemes Lemma 30.11.3 (Tag 08DS), whose support-proper pushforward assertion is reduced to the scheme-theoretic support factorization of Lemma 0CYS (Tag 0CYS) and proper coherence Proposition 30.19.1 (Tag 02O5). No new nodes were needed: the DAG already contains the support factorization, derived direct-image composition, and proper coherence statements. The proof has three steps: factor F through its proper scheme-theoretic support, identify higher direct images by derived composition (using exactness of closed-immersion pushforward), and apply proper coherence. Small cases checked: F=0, i an isomorphism (already proper f), and S=Spec k with Z proper over k.
